name: yazio-mcp
description: MCP server for accessing Yazio user & nutrition data (unofficial)

tools.name: get_user_suggested_products
tools.description: Get suggested products for a meal

tools.name: get_user_consumed_items
tools.description: Get food entries for a date

tools.name: get_user_daily_nutrients
tools.description: Get daily energy and macro totals for a date range

tools.name: add_quick_entry
tools.description: Log a quick entry with total nutrition, without a product

tools.name: add_user_consumed_meal
tools.description: Log a saved meal to the diary

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Get a recipe with ingredients and nutrients

tools.name: update_user_recipe
tools.description: Replace one of your recipes; nutrients are recalculated

tools.name: delete_user_recipe
tools.description: Delete one of your own recipes

tools.name: create_user_meal
tools.description: Save a set of products as a meal

tools.name: get_user_favorites
tools.description: Get your favorite products and recipes

tools.name: get_user_weight
tools.description: Get the last weight entry up to a date

tools.name: get_user_weight_history
tools.description: Get all weight entries in a date range

tools.name: get_user_body_values
tools.description: Get every body value of a day

tools.name: add_user_body_value
tools.description: Log body fat, muscle, blood glucose or a circumference

tools.name: update_user_body_value
tools.description: Change a weight or body value entry

tools.name: set_user_activity
tools.description: Set the day's steps or activity energy

tools.name: get_user_note
tools.description: Get the diary note and feeling tags for a date

tools.name: set_user_note
tools.description: Set the diary note and feeling tags for a date
